tasks.label: Install + register MCP server
tasks.command: python3 -m pip install -e . && opencode mcp add codebase -- "$(python3 -c 'import sys;print(sys.executable)')" mcp_server.py

tasks.label: Big Pickle: analyze this repo
tasks.command: opencode run --model opencode/big-pickle --auto "Use the codebase MCP tools to analyze this project. Tell me what it does, its main components, and two concrete improvements."
